title: Saylani TITAN Sukkur Campus, Sukkur | SMIT Campus Location & Details
text: SMIT Campus: Saylani TITAN Sukkur Campus, located in Sukkur, Pakistan. Address: Military Road Sukkur, opposite to Hotel One. This is one of Saylani Mass IT Training's (SMIT) training centers where free IT courses are delivered on-site. To check current course availability at this campus or enroll, visit https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll and select Sukkur as the city.
